description: Use for any 'how many days between two dates' question: plain date difference, age or duration, or business days. By default, counts all calendar days, including the earlier date and excluding the later date. For business days, set excludeWeekdays, for example [0,6] for Saturday and Sunday. To also skip public holidays, set excludeHolidays and country, and region for a regional calendar. To check if one date is a working day, use the same date as start and end with includeEnd true: days is 1 or 0. Plain reversed dates give a negative count; filtered counts are never negative. If holiday data is unavailable, the call fails. Returns the count, weekday and ISO week of both dates, elapsed years, months and days for plain counts, warnings to read, the rules used and a share link.

country.description: Canonical uppercase ISO country code; discover supported codes with list_locations.

end.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Order does not matter for the count, but a plain reversed count is negative.

excludeHolidays.description: Exclude public holidays, including observed dates, as full days. The data does not mark half-day holidays. Requires country; unavailable holiday data is an error.

excludeWeekdays.description: Weekdays to exclude: 0 Sunday through 6 Saturday. Default none. Use [0,6] for a Saturday and Sunday weekend; some countries have a different weekend, so choose the days for the country.

includeEnd.description: Set true to count both dates (inclusive). Default false.

language.description: Website language, default en. All 32 site languages; nb/no and zh-Hans/zh-cn, zh-Hant/zh-tw aliases are accepted. Holiday names may fall back to their native language. Weekday names in results are always English.

region.description: Exact subdivision code from list_locations; omit for the national calendar.

start.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Order does not matter for the count, but a plain reversed count is negative.

name: count_days

calendarDays.description: All calendar days in the range, before exclusions. Equal to days with no exclusion.

days.description: The answer: the days in the range that are not excluded. Negative only when end is before start and nothing is excluded.

elapsed.description: The span between the two dates as whole years, months and days, for an age or a duration. Never negative. Only with no exclusion.

endDate.description: The end input with its weekday and ISO week.

excludedDays.description: Days in the range that the weekday and holiday exclusions removed. 0 with no exclusion.

excludedHolidayDates.description: Public holidays in the range that were excluded and that are not on an excluded weekday.

filtered.description: True when a weekday or holiday exclusion applied to the count.

country.description: Canonical uppercase ISO country code; discover supported codes with list_locations.

anyOf.description: Exact subdivision code from list_locations; omit for the national calendar.

holidayData.description: Source, version and coverage of the holiday data that the calculation used. Null when it used no holiday data.

months.description: The same span in months, to 2 decimals. Only with no exclusion.

ok.description: Always true. An error result has no structured content.

rules.description: The inputs as the calculation applied them, with defaults filled in, and the rules it followed in words. country is the country that was sent, or null.

Exact subdivision code from list_locations; omit for the national calendar.

timezone.const: UTC calendar dates (no time of day)

shareUrl.description: Link that opens this calculation in the Date Calculator on onlinealarmkur.com.

startDate.description: The start input with its weekday and ISO week.

warnings.description: English notes that change how to read the result; tell the user about them. Empty when there are none.

weeks.description: The same span in weeks, to 2 decimals. Only with no exclusion.

years.description: The same span in years, to 2 decimals. Only with no exclusion.
